parameters.help_en: The ID of the namespace where the application is located. Cross-namespace applications are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用所在命名空间ID，目前不支持跨命名空间的应用
parameters.name: namespace_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the routing rule
parameters.help_zh: 路由规则名称
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance associated with the routing rule.

Server Load Balancer (SLB) includes Classic Load Balancer (CLB) and Application Load Balancer (ALB) instances
parameters.help_zh:
路由规则所使用的SLB实例ID。

负载均衡SLB包括CLB实例和ALB实例
parameters.name: slb_id

parameters.help_en: The listener port for the SLB instance. This port must be available
parameters.help_zh: SLB监听端口，该端口不能被占用
parameters.name: listener_port

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the CLB certificate.

If `LoadBalanceType` is set to `clb`, use this parameter to configure the HTTPS listener certificate.

For more information about how to use SSL certificate IDs for CLB, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/90792.html
parameters.help_zh:
CLB证书ID。取值说明如下：

LoadBalanceType为clb时，使用该字段来配置HTTPS监听证书。

CLB使用SSL证书ID的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/90792.html
parameters.name: cert_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the ALB certificates.

If `LoadBalanceType` is set to `alb`, use this parameter to configure multiple certificates for the HTTPS listener. Separate multiple certificate IDs with a comma (,).

Obtain the SSL certificate ID for an ALB instance from the digital certificate service. For example, if you configure `756***-cn-hangzhou`, `756***` is the certificate ID obtained from the product page and `-cn-hangzhou` is a fixed suffix. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209076.html
parameters.help_zh:
ALB多证书ID。取值说明如下：

LoadBalanceType为alb时，使用该字段来配置HTTPS监听多证书，多个证书ID之间使用逗号分割。

ALB使用的SSL证书ID需要从数字证书产品获取。例如配置`756***-cn-hangzhou`，`756***`为产品页获取的证书ID, `-cn-hangzhou`为固定后缀。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209076.html
parameters.name: cert_ids

parameters.help_en:
The default forwarding rule. Requests that do not match any forwarding rule in the `Rules` parameter are forwarded to the application specified in this rule. The value is a JSON string with the following parameters:

`appId`: The ID of the application.

`containerPort`: The port of the application instance.

This rule serves as a catch-all for traffic that is not handled by other specific forwarding rules
parameters.help_zh:
默认转发规则。按照IP地址，通过指定端口转发流量到指定应用。参数说明如下：

appId：应用ID。
containerPort：应用实例端口。

所有未匹配或不满足Rules转发规则的请求都会转到该指定应用
parameters.name: default_rule

parameters.help_en:
The forwarding rules. These rules route traffic to a specified application based on the domain name and path. The value is a JSON string. Each rule contains the following parameters:

`appId`: The ID of the application.

`containerPort`: The port of the application instance.

`domain`: The domain name.

`path`: The request path.

`backendProtocol`: The protocol used by backend servers. Valid values: `http`, `https`, and `grpc`. Default value: `http`.

`rewritePath`: The rewritten path.

Only ALB supports path rewriting (`RewritePath`). CLB does not support this feature
parameters.help_zh:
转发规则。按照域名和请求路径，通过指定端口转发流量到指定应用。参数说明如下：

appId：应用ID。
containerPort：应用实例端口。
domain：域名。
path：请求路径。
backendProtocol：后端服务协议，支持http/https/grpc，默认值为http。
rewritePath：重写路径。

目前仅有ALB支持设置URL路径重写（RewritePath）功能，CLB不支持此功能
parameters.name: rules

parameters.help_en:
The type of the Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance. This parameter cannot be changed after the routing rule is created. Valid values:

`clb`: Classic Load Balancer (CLB), formerly known as SLB.

`alb`: Application Load Balancer (ALB)
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡SLB的类型。取决于创建路由规则时填写的类型，更新时不可变更。取值说明如下：

clb：传统型负载均衡CLB（原SLB）。
alb：应用型负载均衡ALB
parameters.name: load_balance_type

parameters.help_en:
The request forwarding protocol. Valid values:

`HTTP`: for applications that do not require encryption.

`HTTPS`: suitable for applications that require encrypted data transmission
parameters.help_zh:
请求转发协议。取值说明如下：

HTTP：适用于需要对数据内容进行识别的应用。
HTTPS：适用于需要加密传输的应用
parameters.name: listener_protocol

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security policy instance
parameters.help_zh: 安全策略实例 ID
parameters.name: security_policy_id

parameters.help_en: The request timeout, in seconds. Valid values: 1 to 180. If a backend server does not respond within the timeout period, the load balancer stops waiting and returns an HTTP 504 error to the client
parameters.help_zh:
指定请求超时时间。单位：秒。取值范围：1~180。
如果在超时时间内后端服务器一直没有响应，负载均衡将放弃等待，给客户端返回HTTP 504错误码
parameters.name: request_timeout

parameters.help_en: The connection idle timeout, in seconds. Valid values: 1 to 60. If no request is received within the timeout period, the load balancer temporarily closes the connection. The connection is re-established when the next request is received
parameters.help_zh:
指定连接空闲超时时间。单位：秒。取值范围：1~60。
如果在超时时间内一直没有访问请求，负载均衡会暂时中断当前连接，直到一下次请求来临时重新建立新的连接
parameters.name: idle_timeout

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-For` header to retrieve the IP address of the client
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启通过X-Forwarded-For头字段获取来访者客户端IP
parameters.name: enable_xforwarded_for

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Port` header to retrieve the source port of the client
parameters.help_zh: 是否通过X-Forwarded-Port头字段获取负载均衡实例的监听端口
parameters.name: enable_xforwarded_for_client_src_port

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Proto` header to retrieve the listener protocol of the load balancer instance
parameters.help_zh: 是否通过X-Forwarded-Proto头字段获取负载均衡实例的监听协议
parameters.name: enable_xforwarded_for_proto

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use the `SLB-ID` header to retrieve the ID of the load balancer instance
parameters.help_zh: 是否通过SLB-ID头字段获取负载均衡实例ID
parameters.name: enable_xforwarded_for_slb_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Port` header to retrieve the listener port of the load balancer instance
parameters.help_zh: 是否通过X-Forwarded-Port头字段获取负载均衡实例的监听端口
parameters.name: enable_xforwarded_for_slb_port

parameters.help_en:
The address type. Valid values:

`Internet`: A public address.

`Intranet`: A private address
parameters.help_zh:
地址类型：
Internet：公网地址。
Intranet：私网地址
parameters.name: address_type

parameters.help_en:
The edition of the Application Load Balancer (ALB) instance. Different editions have different features and billing policies. Valid values:

`Standard`: Standard edition.

`StandardWithWaf`: WAF-enhanced edition
parameters.help_zh:
应用型负载均衡的版本，不同版本有不同功能限制和计费策略。取值：

Standard：标准版。

StandardWithWaf：WAF增强版
parameters.name: load_balancer_edition

parameters.help_en:
A JSON string that contains the mappings between availability zones and VSwitches. If the current region supports two or more availability zones, you must specify at least two. A ZoneMapping consists of the following parameters:

`VSwitchId`: a string that specifies the ID of the VSwitch that corresponds to the availability zone. Each availability zone can have only one VSwitch and one subnet.

`ZoneId`: a string that specifies the ID of the availability zone for the load balancer instance
parameters.help_zh:
可用区及交换机映射列表的JSON字符串。若当前地域支持 2 个及以上的可用区，至少需要添加 2 个可用区。一个ZoneMapping结构为：

VSwitchId，String类型，可用区对应的交换机，每个可用区只能使用一台交换机和一个子网。

ZoneId，String类型，网络型负载均衡实例的可用区 ID
parameters.name: zone_mappings

parameters.help_en: Specifies the Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) configuration
parameters.help_zh: 跨域配置
parameters.name: cors_config

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable Gzip for data compression
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启数据压缩
parameters.name: enable_gzip

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code. Valid values:

2xx: The request is successful.

3xx: The request is redirected.

4xx: A request error occurs.

5xx: A server error occurs
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

IngressId.description_en: The ID of the routing rule

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code.

This parameter is not returned if the request is successful.

This parameter is returned if the request fails. For more information, see the Error codes section in this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码列表

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request is successful, success is returned.

If the request fails, an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
附加信息。取值说明如下：

请求正常，返回success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the routing rule was created. Valid values:

true: The routing rule was created.

false: The routing rule failed to be created
Success.description_zh:
创建路由规则是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：创建成功。
false：创建失败

TraceId.description_en: The trace ID that is used to query the details of the request
TraceId.description_zh: 调用链ID，用于精确查询调用信息
